functional.description: Use a single installation-wide product locale selected during first installation, persist it, preserve it through restart/update, and allow the streamer to change it in the protected panel.
functional.rationale: Keep all product surfaces consistent while allowing the operator to select a preferred language.

functional.description: Support complete first-party catalogs for pt-BR, en, and es, with pt-BR as safe default and source locale.
functional.rationale: These are the product owner's selected initial languages.

functional.description: Localize product-authored UI, setup/callback copy, chat commands/help/replies, OBS widget product labels, and host lifecycle-tool copy.
functional.rationale: The product owner explicitly expanded FND-8 beyond frontend-only translation.

functional.description: Store translations as contributor-editable files split by module and locale, with a documented template and automated validation.
functional.rationale: The product owner selected one catalog file per module and language to let the community contribute in bounded areas.

functional.description: Resolve stable command IDs into the active locale's global root, subcommand syntax, help and responses; use !fila for pt-BR, !queue for English, and !cola for Spanish, with no legacy aliases.
functional.rationale: The owner approved locale-specific roots and explicitly rejected legacy aliases.

functional.description: Map stable public API status/error identifiers to localized copy without returning internal enum text, provider errors, secrets or technical details to browser/chat.
functional.rationale: Preserve the existing security boundary while localizing visible product messages.

functional.description: Fall back deterministically to pt-BR for an unknown locale or missing community key; require complete first-party catalogs before shipping.
functional.rationale: Never show raw keys or machine identifiers to a streamer/viewer.

functional.description: Localize the unified installer menu delivered by OPS-5, with one distributed file per operating system. Install/start, update, and uninstall are actions in that file, not separate names/files.
functional.rationale: The owner requested international tool names, dependency handling, updater and uninstaller behavior.

functional.description: Use explicit-locale plural, date, time and number formatting, while preserving UTC data and the existing maximum chat message length.
functional.rationale: Avoid locale-sensitive presentation bugs without changing persistence contracts.

functional.description: Preserve streamer-authored content exactly as entered when changing locale; localize only product-owned text. Never silently overwrite or automatically translate persisted values.
functional.rationale: Owner-approved policy on 2026-10-06 prevents silent changes to operator-authored content.

nonFunctional.description: Catalog strings and interpolated values are always rendered as text; no translated content is evaluated as HTML, code or shell input.
nonFunctional.metric: Tests inject HTML/script-like values through UI, chat, and widget copy with zero DOM/script execution.

nonFunctional.description: Raw backend/provider exception text, credentials, tokens and internal enums are not exposed by localized APIs or messages.
nonFunctional.metric: API/chat/DOM/log tests assert absence of secret sentinels and internal exception text.

nonFunctional.description: The saved locale survives application and PostgreSQL restarts and image updates; the initial installer choice never overwrites an existing saved value.
nonFunctional.metric: Migration-backed PostgreSQL integration test covers seed, restart, update-default conflict, and locale mutation.

nonFunctional.description: Language changes update product-authored panel, chat and OBS presentation without requiring an API process restart.
nonFunctional.metric: Protected locale mutation is reflected by subsequent projections and chat handling without restart.

nonFunctional.description: First-party locale catalogs have validated required-key, placeholder and plural-form parity; community locales fail closed to pt-BR on missing content.
nonFunctional.metric: CI validation reports exact locale/module/key and runtime fallback never returns raw keys.

nonFunctional.description: Local lifecycle tools identify missing Docker/Compose and present an understandable supported next step in the selected language.
nonFunctional.metric: Platform contract tests cover available, missing, declined installation and preserve/delete choices.

constraints.description: Application code remains JavaScript ESM with JSDoc; frontend stays vanilla HTML/CSS/JavaScript without TypeScript, framework, transpiler or bundler.
Runtime remains local-first with Fastify, PostgreSQL/Prisma and Docker Compose; no hosted translation, localization or synchronization service is introduced.
One installation-wide locale is selected initially by the installer and can later be changed by the streamer in the panel.
Initial first-party languages are pt-BR, English and Spanish; pt-BR is default and source locale.
Catalog files are divided by module and locale; command roots are !fila, !queue and !cola with no cross-locale or legacy aliases.
Technical identifiers, schema, logs and API contract fields remain stable; local catalogs contain text, not executable templates or backend-derived raw errors.
OPS-5 delivers one installer artifact per operating system with a menu for install/start, update, and uninstall; FND-8 localizes these action labels and does not define three separate filenames.
Host utility scripts cannot assume Node.js, Python, jq, a running API, or a browser is installed before checking/installing Docker/Compose.

assumptions.description: An installation has one effective locale at a time; locale per viewer, queue or browser is outside scope.
The existing JSON Setting store can persist product_locale; the host-local projection is a separate recoverable file.
pt-BR is complete first-party catalog source; en/es translations will be maintained with the feature before release.
Streamer-authored values are preserved verbatim across locale changes; approved by the owner.
OPS-5 owns cross-platform consolidation and Actions packaging of one installer per operating system; FND-8 localizes that file’s menu and messages.

domainModel.description: Validated locale code, stored as a non-secret installation setting with revision/audit metadata.
relationships: One installation has one effective locale.

domainModel.description: Versioned local UTF-8 TSV resource per module/locale with literal text and allowlisted placeholders; cross-platform contract still requires tests.
relationships: A locale has one catalog per supported product module.

domainModel.description: Stable internal command ID and authorization policy mapped to locale-specific root/subcommand syntax and help copy.
relationships: A command ID has localized presentation in each first-party locale.

domainModel.description: Streamer-authored queue/reward/template/widget content is distinct from catalog text and is preserved verbatim across locale changes.
relationships: Persisted values are never automatically translated or rewritten.

flow: Show language selection in the host installer
Bootstrap application settings only when no locale exists

states.error: Show localized dependency/bootstrap failure and supported next action
states.empty: New installation starts with chosen locale or pt-BR fallback

flow: Select pt-BR/en/es or an approved community locale
Validate locale and current setting revision
Refresh product-owned text in subsequent panel/chat/OBS projections

states.error: Keep previous locale and show localized safe error

flow: Translate only documented keys and placeholders
Open review request with completeness report

states.error: Identify invalid locale/key/placeholder without executing catalog content
states.empty: A missing optional locale remains unavailable and runtime falls back to pt-BR

edgeCases.scenario: Saved locale is missing, malformed or unsupported during startup.
edgeCases.handling: Resolve to pt-BR, persist the normalized safe value when possible, and do not expose the supplied raw string.

edgeCases.scenario: Community catalog is incomplete or has mismatched placeholders/plural forms.
edgeCases.handling: CI/local validator identifies module and key; locale is not selectable until approved; runtime missing-key fallback uses pt-BR.

edgeCases.scenario: Locale is changed while chat or OBS requests are in flight.
edgeCases.handling: Each operation uses one resolved locale snapshot; later operations use the latest persisted locale; do not mix languages inside one response.

edgeCases.scenario: Translated/interpolated content contains HTML, shell syntax, command tokens, control characters or an overlength chat result.
edgeCases.handling: Treat as plain text, reject prohibited catalog structure, constrain arguments, and apply existing chat length behavior without splitting into spam.

edgeCases.scenario: Host lifecycle utility runs before the API/database is available or after containers have stopped.
edgeCases.handling: Read a bounded locale source usable by host tools and use pt-BR fallback; never require credentials or print database secrets.

edgeCases.scenario: Streamer changes locale while queue/reward/widget custom text is stored.
edgeCases.handling: Preserve stored text exactly as entered; localize product-owned labels only. No automatic rewrite/translation.

terminology.definition: Language and regional format identifier such as pt-BR, en or es; a single locale applies to one local installation.
avoid: browser language as the source of truth

terminology.definition: Text authored and shipped by this project, including panel labels, help/replies, generated widget labels and lifecycle-tool prompts.
Queue/reward names and descriptions, templates, and fixed widget text authored by the streamer; distinct from catalogs and preserved exactly as entered across locale changes.
Stable internal identifier used by parsing/authorization, independent of localized display syntax.

openQuestions.question: Which verification/test process proves the selected contract: PostgreSQL as authority and an atomically updated, revisioned, recoverable host-readable projection available offline to local tools?
openQuestions.status: architecture selected in spec v3; crash, write-failure, corruption, stale/offline, recovery, and Compose tests still block the implementation gate

openQuestions.question: Which safe, supported platform package-manager flows can the installer offer for Docker/Compose on Windows, Ubuntu/Linux and macOS, and where must it fall back to manual instructions?
openQuestions.status: verify per platform during installer implementation; never elevate/install silently

openQuestions.question: How should the selected UTF-8 no-BOM TSV catalog contract, allowlisted placeholders, and plural selection be validated across browser ESM, Node ESM, and host tools without pre-Docker runtime dependencies?
openQuestions.status: architecture contract selected in spec v3; parser/encoding/safe-parity contract tests are required before closing the gate

openQuestions.question: Should streamer-authored content continue to be displayed exactly as entered after locale changes, or should any field have its own locale? Persisted data must never be overwritten without consent.
openQuestions.status: resolved by product owner on 2026-10-06: preserve authored text exactly; localize only product-owned copy

openQuestions.question: How should existing slugs/aliases that collide with fila/queue/cola global roots be resolved? Recommendation: detect and block only activation of the conflicting root until the streamer explicitly renames the key in the panel; never rename automatically.
openQuestions.status: resolved by product owner on 2026-10-06: block only the conflicting root and require explicit panel rename; never rename automatically

openQuestions.question: Should separate names for local lifecycle files be retained? Historical question superseded by the owner decision to use one unified installer.
openQuestions.status: superseded by owner decision on 2026-10-07: one unified installer artifact per OS; install/update/uninstall are menu actions, not separate files.

decisions.decision: The install-selected locale initializes a single persisted installation locale that the streamer can later change in the panel.
Community translations are split into one file per module and locale.
Global command roots are !fila (pt-BR), !queue (en), and !cola (es); do not retain legacy/cross-locale aliases.
FND-8 covers the full product surfaces listed in the spec, including chat and local lifecycle tools, not only the frontend.
Preserve streamer-authored values exactly as entered and localize product-owned copy only; never auto-translate or rewrite stored values.
Use local literal UTF-8 TSV catalogs, a narrow resolver, and native Intl; do not add i18next without a demonstrated browser/script integration need.
decisions.status: selected by architecture review in spec v3; verify with contract tests

decisions.decision: The previously proposed separate tool filenames are superseded by OPS-5: one unified installer per operating system; lifecycle actions are menu choices.
decisions.status: superseded 2026-10-07 by owner decision; see D-10

decisions.decision: Preserve streamer-authored names, descriptions, templates, and widget fixed text exactly as entered across product locale changes; localize only product-owned strings. Never translate or rewrite stored values automatically.

When an existing queue slug/alias collides with a reserved global root, preserve stored keys, block only the conflicting root, and require an explicit operator rename in the panel. Never rename automatically.
OPS-5 provides one unified installer artifact per OS; install/start, update, and uninstall are menu actions, not separate file names or downloads.
